# Tested preview packages

[Download the v6.1 preview ZIP](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-13-v6.1.zip) ([SHA-256](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-13-v6.1.zip.sha256)) for the tested fstool host-tool update. It prefers fstool, retains mtfs compatibility, and includes the on-screen file picker, loading spinner, block counter, source, preassembled programs, documentation, tests, and sample media. Unpack it into your installation's FunStuff directory, preserving any existing SignalAnalysis installation first. Run make check before editing or rebuilding.

The archive is a complete SignalAnalysis directory with its own integrity manifest; it excludes this dist directory and all machine-specific snapshots, tape assignments, and runtime state. The package was prepared and tested on 13 November 2026.

Historical builds remain available: [v6](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-13-v6.zip) predates fstool discovery, and [v4](SignalAnalysis-preview-2026-11-12-v4.zip) predates the file picker and loading indicators.
